copy.arcadeText: Play Agerdin’s own games, made with the feel of an old neighbourhood computer shop. Every game in the playable room runs here.
copy.arcadeArchiveTag: 9 Agerdin-made arcade games play here · other titles are memories
copy.playFoot: Computer-shop games and the folk-game archive each have their own page.
copy.cabinetNote: All 9 original arcade games below run on this site. Choose one to start.
copy.cabinetFoot: These games run inside Agerdin. Original computer-shop titles are kept in the memory archive; the playable arcade games here are original creations.
copy.cabinetRoadText: Steer around traffic using the keyboard, on-screen buttons, or a touchpad.
copy.cabinetSnakeText: Inspired by old mobile pixel games: collect food, grow longer, and avoid the wall and your tail.
copy.cabinetBrickText: Return the ball with your paddle, clear the coloured bricks, and mind your three lives.
copy.cabinetDuelText: Jump, guard, and use two attacks to beat your rival. Each opponent has a different style.
copy.cabinetRescueText: Cross the street, dodge incoming fire, and fight back. Move, jump, and shoot.
copy.cabinetPenaltyText: Take five shots. Choose direction and height to outwit a varied goalkeeper.
copy.cabinetCityText: Drive around the neighbourhood and deliver four parcels. Use WASD or the arrow keys.
copy.snakeIntro: Use the arrow keys or WASD. The round ends if you hit your tail or a wall.
copy.snakeOverlayText: Collect the dots and grow as long as you can.
copy.snakeHelp: Use W/A/S/D or the arrow keys. On touch screens, use the direction buttons.
copy.brickIntro: Move the paddle to return the ball. Clear every brick before you run out of lives.
copy.brickOverlayText: Return the ball and clear the bricks. You have three lives.
copy.brickHelp: Move with A/D or ←/→; use W/S or +/− to change paddle width. Four touch buttons are below.
copy.arcadeShelfNote: Nine original Agerdin arcade games play here. The memory shelf below links to selected outside pages; each card labels publisher information separately from third-party play pages.

copy.racerIntro: Use A/D or ←/→ to steer. Hold W to speed up and S to slow down; avoid the other cars.
copy.racerControlNote: A/D or ←/→ to steer; hold W to speed up and S to slow down. Touch buttons are also available.

hand: Choose to bat or bowl, then play by showing a number on your hand.
kata: Mark one square at a time. Three in a row wins.
penfight: Flick the rival pen toward the edge while keeping yours on the desk.
odd-even: Show your fingers and call whether the total will be odd or even.
five-stones: Toss a stone, pick up the right ones, then catch it.
notebook-cricket: Play a one-over chase. Pick 1–6: matching batter and bowler numbers mean out; otherwise the batter scores that number.
paper-football: Move the ball across the notebook grid to the far goal.
ludo: Race all four tokens around the board. Use safe squares, captures, and bonus turns.
bantumi: Sow seeds around your pits, collect them in your store, and capture from an empty pit.

playCopy.playClassicNote: Choose a short game played with hands, pens, stones, or a notebook.

playCopy.handStatusSetup: Which turn would you like to start with?
playCopy.kataInstructions: You are ✕ and the computer is ○. Try to line up three marks.

hand.title: Hand Cricket
hand.text: A short one-over match. Bat or bowl, taking turns against the computer.

kata.title: Kata-Kuti
kata.text: Line up three marks on a grid against the computer.

penfight.title: Pen Fight
penfight.text: Choose a light or strong flick and push the rival pen off the desk.

five-stones.title: Five Stones
five-stones.text: Toss one stone, collect the rest, and clear the singles and pairs stages.

notebook-cricket.title: Notebook Cricket
notebook-cricket.text: Play a six-ball match with 1–6 choices on a notebook scorecard.

paper-football.title: Paper Football
paper-football.text: Move the ball across a notebook grid and reach the opponent’s goal.

ludo.title: Ludo
ludo.text: Bring tokens out with a six, race all 52 spaces, and use safe squares and captures.

bantumi.title: Bantumi
bantumi.text: Sow seeds into your store; finish in an empty pit to capture the seeds opposite.

odd-even.title: Odd and Even
odd-even.text: Call the parity of the total fingers and win the five-round match.

categoryDescriptions.chase: Games of tagging, seeking, and running away.

categoryDescriptions.board: Games built around marked ground, pieces, shells, or a board.
categoryDescriptions.rhymes: Games carried by rhymes, songs, and spoken chants.
categoryDescriptions.pretend: Make-believe games about home life, weddings, and picnics.
categoryDescriptions.events: Records of folk gatherings, festival games, and water play.

classicArcadeText.duelIntro: A fresh rival is picked for each bout. Move with A/D, jump with W, guard with S; J punches and K kicks.
classicArcadeText.duelHelp: A/D move · W jump · S guard · J punch · K kick · Rival style changes every bout
classicArcadeText.rescueIntro: Cross the neighbourhood street and clear 12 opponents. Move with A/D, jump with W, and fire with J or SPACE. You have three lives.
classicArcadeText.rescueHelp: A/D move · W jump · J or SPACE fire · Clear 12 targets before three hits
classicArcadeText.penaltyIntro: Take five penalties. Use A/D to aim left or right, W/S to aim high or low, then press SPACE. The goalkeeper can learn from your previous shots.
classicArcadeText.penaltyHelp: A/D change direction · W/S height · SPACE shoot · Score more goals in five shots
classicArcadeText.cityIntro: Collect four parcels and finish the neighbourhood route. Drive with WASD or the arrow keys; building blocks slow you down.
classicArcadeText.cityHelp: WASD / arrow keys to drive · collect four parcels · finish before time runs out or you hit three times
classicArcadeText.block: Building block—follow the road around it.
classicArcadeText.opponentWins: They had a little more fight left. Ready for a rematch?
